params.name: number
params.description: Page number starting at 1. The default value is 1.

params.name: size
params.description: Number of results per page. The default value is 50.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort field and order. For ascending sort order, use the '+[FieldName]' format. For descending order, use '-[FieldName]' format. The default value is '-createdOn'.

params.name: createdOn
params.description: Date filter, defined by upper or lower inclusive limits, in Unix timestamp format. Acceptable values are: gte([timestamp]) - 'greater than or equal to'; lte([timestamp]) - 'less than or equal to'.

params.name: status
params.description: Subscription status (valid values are PENDING_REQUIRED_DATA, PENDING_SEAT_AVAILABILITY, PENDING_USER_ACTIVATION, PENDING_REMOTE_CREATION, SUBSCRIPTION_SUSPENDED_FREE_TRIAL_EXPIRED, SUBSCRIPTION_SUSPENDED_RENEW_CONTRACT, SUBSCRIPTION_SUSPENDED_PAY_INVOICE, SUBSCRIPTION_SUSPENDED_MANUAL_SUSPENSION, FAILED, ACTIVE, PENDING_REMOTE_CANCELLATION, CANCELLED). The filter format is: in([status], ...).

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: Subscription ID purchased by the Reseller company

params.name: userId
params.description: User ID. Use the in([id], ...) format to filter by multiple IDs, or the userId=[id] format to filter by a single ID.
